snippet.title: [TAS] PSX Salary Man Champ: Tatakau Salary Man "1 player" in 18:09.800 by mz
snippet.description:
This is a tool-assisted speedrun. For more information, see https://tasvideos.org/1522M
TAS originally published on 2010-05-14

This obscure Japan-only Success title is a collection of button-mashing minigames parodying the life of a Japanese salary man (your average white-collar wage worker).  If you're looking for weird Japanese humor, look no further than this run.


#tas #tasvideos #toolassisted #toolassistedspeedrun #speedrun
